title_sq: Buze Unazes Se Vogel, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Lokacion Dhe Orientim Perfekt!!

title_en: Buze Ringaze Se Vogel, 2+1 apartment for sale, with perfect location and orientation!!
description_en: On the edge of Vogel Ring, on Bardhyl Street, near the 4 Deshmoret School, 2+1 apartment for sale, with a perfect location!!! The apartment is located on the third floor of an existing four-story building. The apartment has an actual area of ​​63.5 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room together with the dining and cooking area and exit to the balcony, two bedrooms, a balcony and a bathroom with a window. The apartment is completely invested from scratch, starting with plastering, new electrical and plumbing installations, parquet, double-glazed plastic windows, internal and external doors, flush toilet, etc. The area offers many facilities, starting from the perfect location, the proximity to the Center and the institutions, and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment, since the rents are very high in that area. The orientation of the apartment is south-east and west, which makes it have natural light and sun all day. It has full mortgage documentation.
